name: Forlorn Rowe
summary: At Raven Hill Cemetery's northern edge, Forlorn Rowe lies beneath a shadow of dread. Morbent Fel makes his home there, and his magic raises the restless dead across Duskwood.

sections.title: A Seat of Necromancy
sections.body: Forlorn Rowe climbs the northern edge of Raven Hill Cemetery in gloom. Morbent Fel makes his home on the hill. The necromancer raises many of the dead who roam the surrounding wilderness. From above, his foul enchantments command skeletal servants, making Duskwood's northwestern corner perilous for travelers.

sections.title: Cleansing the Hill
sections.body: Morbent Fel's hold on Forlorn Rowe cannot be broken with ordinary steel. Dark enchantments shield him from mortal weapons until relics of holy power weaken him. To bring down the necromancer and break his hold over the woods, adventurers must find consecrated arms and strike at the curse smothering the cemetery grounds.

faq.q: Where is the Forlorn Rowe located?
faq.answer: Forlorn Rowe rises along Raven Hill Cemetery's northern ridge in northwestern Duskwood, overlooking the cemetery.

faq.q: Who lives at the Forlorn Rowe?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel makes his lair at Forlorn Rowe. The powerful necromancer uses dark arcane rites to raise and command the undead who wander Duskwood.

faq.q: Why is Morbent Fel so hard to fight here?
faq.answer: Morbent Fel shields himself with foul sorcery. Ordinary attacks are nearly useless until a consecrated relic made to dispel his magic strips away his protections.

faq.q: Is the Forlorn Rowe part of the cemetery?
faq.answer: Yes. Forlorn Rowe rises along Raven Hill Cemetery's northern boundary, overlooking the graves and crypts below.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face dark rites at Forlorn Rowe that defy the Holy Light. Consecrated relics and righteous wrath can pierce the necromancer's wards.
As an Alliance member, you know driving Morbent Fel from Forlorn Rowe is vital to bringing some safety back to Duskwood's western border.
